name: Rope of Entanglement

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Entangle
powers.text: Magic action: the rope lashes a creature within 20 ft: a DC 15 Dex save or Restrained (escape: DC 15 Strength or Dexterity check).

summary: It lashes out and binds a creature within 20 ft (Dex DC 15; DC 15 to escape).
text: A 30-foot rope. Holding one end, you can spend a Magic action to make the other end lash out at a creature within 20 feet that you can see; the target must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 15) or have the Restrained condition. Speaking a command word as a Bonus Action frees it. A creature Restrained by the rope can use an action to attempt a Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Athletics) check (DC 15, its choice), breaking free on a success. Its AC is 20 and it has 20 Hit Points; it recovers 1 Hit Point each 5 minutes provided it still has 1 or more, and it is destroyed if reduced to 0 Hit Points.
